CustomField.description: Whether the point is a steuerbare Verbrauchseinrichtung. Encodes both halves of the rule: the 4.2 kW threshold, which appears nowhere in § 14a itself and comes entirely from BNetzA BK6-22-300, and the exclusion the statute does state in its own words - nicht oeffentlich-zugaengliche Ladepunkte fuer Elektromobile. So making a point public switches this OFF while switching four other regimes on. Note the guaranteed 4.2 kW is a dimming floor on what the operator may INSTRUCT, not on what the device does: a relay-only wallbox is lawfully taken to zero and cannot claim the hardship exemption for that inability.
CustomField.label: § 14a EnWG pflichtig
